name: Morning Spine Wake-Up
note: Cat-cow into thread-the-needle into low cobra. Five rounds, slow.
description: Ten gentle minutes to take the night out of your spine. Move slowly — the point is to feel each segment wake up, not to stretch hard.
steps: Child's Pose · 1 min — settle and find the breath
Cat–Cow · 8 rounds — move with the breath
Thread the Needle · 1 min each side
Low Cobra · 5 rounds — lift only as far as is easy
Downward Dog · 1 min — pedal the heels out
Standing Forward Fold · 1 min — soft knees

name: Hip Opener Sequence
note: Pigeon, lizard, half-frog. Hold longer than feels comfortable.
description: Twenty minutes to undo a desk. These are longer holds — let the tissue release on its own time instead of forcing it.

name: Post-Run Restore
note: Long forward folds, supine twist, legs-up-the-wall.
description: Fifteen minutes to cash the check your legs just wrote. Best done within an hour of finishing the run.
steps: Standing Forward Fold · 2 min — let the hamstrings lengthen
Low Lunge with quad reach · 90 sec each side
Reclined IT-band stretch · 90 sec each side

name: Pre-Sleep Yin
note: Five poses, three minutes each. Lights out within 20 of finishing.
description: Long, passive holds to drop the nervous system into park. Dim the lights, breathe slow, and aim to be in bed within twenty minutes of finishing.

name: Standing Wake-Up (No Mat)
note: Done it on hotel floors and gas-station parking lots. Works.
description: Five minutes, no mat, no floor required. Built for hotel rooms and parking lots — anywhere you can stand.
steps: Standing side bend · 30 sec each side
Standing quad stretch · 30 sec each side

name: Shoulder Reset
note: Banded pulls, prone Y/T/W, gentle thoracic openers.
description: Twelve minutes to undo rounded shoulders and keep the rotator cuff honest. Light band, slow tempo, no momentum.
steps: Thread the Needle · 1 min each side
Thoracic extension over a roller · 90 sec
Doorway pec stretch · 1 min each side
